{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999].shape[0]}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id values: {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check sample_seq per patient_id to confirm re-testing
sample_seq_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq (re-tested): {sample_seq_counts[sample_seq_counts > 1].shape[0]} (expected: 24)")

# Check assay_batch unit issue: batch B values should be divided by 10
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")
print(f"Mean biomarker_final in batch A: {df[df['assay_batch'] == 'A']['biomarker_final'].mean()}")
print(f"Mean biomarker_final in batch B: {df[df['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final'].mean()}")"}
